system.description:
Dwarves are very particular about their boundaries. This skill teaches the art of constructing sturdy fences and walls, and the etiquette of deciding where they should lie.

Obstacles: Dividing farm fields, Ob 1. Dividing pasturage, Ob 2. Dividing mines and veins, Ob 3. Dividing tax districts, Ob 4.

FoRKs: Chronology of Kings, Mason Accounting, Carpenter

Skill Type: Special. Tools: Yes. Expendable.

Restrictions: Dwarves only in character burning

Root: Per

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 272
